segments.text:
V. 64.
Hereafter ſhall ye ſee the Son of man—He ſpeaks in the third Perſon, modeſtly, and yet p••inly; Sitting on the right-hand of power —That is, the Right-hand of GOD: And coming upon the clouds of heaven—As He is repreſented by Daniel (ch. vii. 13, 14.) Our LORD looked very unlike that Perſon now! But nothing could be more awful, more majeſtic and becoming, than ſuch an Admonition, in ſuch Circumſtances!
